Placoid_Denticle_Armor.description: A hide completely covered in microscopic, tooth-like dermal denticles rather than standard scales. Ribbed with longitudinal grooves, it channels water perfectly to eliminate turbulence, while acting as agonizing natural sandpaper to anything brushing against it.

Mucous_Cycloid_Scales.description: Smooth, overlapping cycloid scales coated in a thick, continuously secreted layer of glycoproteins (mucus). It acts as a primary immune defense against aquatic parasites and makes the entity nearly impossible to grapple firmly.
